blurb: Movement San Francisco offers indoor rock climbing with bouldering and rope climbing, yoga and fitness classes, and a fully stocked gear shop. Members have unlimited access to climbing, yoga, and fitness at all Movement gyms. The gym provides rental gear and hosts skill-building clinics and guest passes.
extraNote: Member referral credit limited to $25/month · Active Duty, Seniors (65+), Teachers, and First Responders get 10% discount for day passes and $0 initiation on memberships
